signature: _add_resolved_extra_edge(caller_fqn, edge, phase_fqns, callees_map, callers_map, all_callees_map, edge_aliases_map) -> bool
pre_condition: caller_fqn is a canonical FQN string (separator '::'). edge has a callee_fqn attribute containing a canonical FQN string and an info_names attribute containing an iterable of strings. phase_fqns is a set of canonical FQN strings representing in-scope functions. callees_map, callers_map, and all_callees_map are mutable dicts keyed by FQN strings whose values are mutable sets; all_callees_map already contains caller_fqn as a key with a set value. edge_aliases_map is a mutable nested dict of shape dict[FQN][FQN] whose innermost values are mutable sets; it already contains edge.callee_fqn -> caller_fqn as nested keys with set values.
post_condition: The function registers a directed supplemental call edge from caller_fqn to callee_fqn. When caller_fqn equals callee_fqn (self-edge): no map is mutated, returns False. Otherwise, after the call: (1) all_callees_map[caller_fqn] contains callee_fqn — the edge is recorded in the complete callee set regardless of phase membership; (2) edge_aliases_map[callee_fqn][caller_fqn] contains every string from edge.info_names — the edge's alias names are recorded unconditionally; (3) when callee_fqn is a member of phase_fqns: callees_map[caller_fqn] contains callee_fqn AND callers_map[callee_fqn] contains caller_fqn — the edge is recorded in the phase-scoped forward and reverse maps; (4) when callee_fqn is NOT a member of phase_fqns: callees_map and callers_map are unchanged for this edge. Returns True when callee_fqn was absent from all_callees_map[caller_fqn] prior to the call (a new edge was registered); returns False when callee_fqn was already present. No element of any map is removed by this function.
